scope: Server-owned unanswered-call expiry, privacy-preserving unread-DM email producers and supported advanced desktop notification controls.
implementation: The server owns the 30-second ringing deadline and reserves both participants. Terminal transitions cancel timers; no_answer reaches both participants. Only the receiver receives a generic missed-call queue item. Client no longer races an independent caller timer, and stale end events cannot close a different call.

Accepted nonself DM messages enqueue generic email after 10 minutes, expiring after 24 hours, deduplicated by message ID. Delivery rechecks exact-message existence, accepted membership, unread watermark/count, directional blocks, verified address and current category consent. No message body, ciphertext or sender identity is included in email.

Advanced settings expose 0/3/5/10-second desktop delay, existing duration/volume/TTS controls and truthful running-app/OS limitations. Pending notifications coalesce by tag and recheck current account, authorization, visibility, focus and DND before delivery. Sounds and calls are not delayed.
